title: Choose an artifact against a release contract
description: Select a measured model profile, a product policy, and traffic volume. A model is releasable only when quality and resource gates pass together.
fixtureNote: All measurements are an illustrative validation fixture for learning release decisions. They are not fastText product benchmarks and must not be reused as capacity or quality promises.

profiles.label: Unigram baseline
profiles.detail: Small full-precision baseline with weaker minority-class recall.

profiles.label: Full bigram model
profiles.detail: Best fixture quality, with a larger file and slower measured p95.

profiles.label: Quantized bigram model
profiles.detail: Compressed artifact that trades some measured quality for size.

policies.label: Edge routing
policies.detail: Tight file and latency budgets with a reviewed quality floor.

policies.label: High-consequence triage
policies.detail: Critical-class recall dominates; a larger artifact is acceptable.

policies.label: General API
policies.detail: Balanced service limits with a moderate artifact budget.
